data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

### Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe
**Prep time:** 15 minutes

#### Ingredients
- 2 cups all-purpose flour

- 1 large egg

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutes

Cook Time: 20 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-22 minutes, until golden brown.
  9. Let cool slightly before serving.

Notes

For best results, use cold ingredients and avoid overmixing the dough.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Nutritional Information (per scone):
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

User Reviews: 4.7/5 stars (243 reviews)

Perfect Blueberry Scones

  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Nutritional Information (per scone):
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g

note.content:
# 2026 Q1 OKRs - Key Objectives and Key Results

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization
- **KR1**: Migrate 80% of legacy services to microservices architecture by end of Q1
- **KR2**: Achieve 99.5% API uptime across all migrated services
- **KR3**: Reduce average API response time by 30% compared to Q4 2025
- **Status**: On track - 45% migration completed

## Objective 2: User Growth & Engagement
- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

## Key Dependencies & Risks:
1. Engineering team capacity constraints may affect Objective 3 timelines
2. Market research for new geographic expansion delayed by vendor issues
3. Budget approval for new hiring still pending from finance

## Next Review: 2026-02-15
## Last Updated: 2026-01-28

data.html_content:
Blueberry Scones

Prep Time: 15 minutes

Cook Time: 20 minutes

Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, cold and cubed
  • 1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Cut in the cold butter using a pastry blender or your fingers until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
  4. Gently fold in the blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
  7. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into an 8-inch circle. Cut into 8 wedges.
  8. Place wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake for 18-22 minutes, until golden brown.
  9. Let cool slightly before serving.

Notes

For best results, use cold ingredients and avoid overmixing the dough.

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

Baker's Tips

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_title: Perfect Blueberry Scones Recipe | Coded Culinary
data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

- Prep time: 15 minutes

**Ingredients:**

- 1/2 teaspoon salt

- 2/3 cup heavy cream
- 1 large egg
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. Whisk together dry ingredients.

7. Pat dough into 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on baking sheet.
9. Brush with extra cream and sprinkle coarse sugar if desired.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool briefly on sheet then transfer to wire rack.

**Baker's Tips:**
- Keep ingredients cold for flakier scones
- Frozen blueberries work well too
- Don't overmix the dough

  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.

data.page_content:
Perfect Blueberry Scones

Prep time: 15 minutes | Cook time: 18 minutes | Difficulty: Easy

Ingredients

  • 2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • 1/2 teaspoon salt
  • 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
  • 1 cup fresh blueberries
  • 2/3 cup heavy cream
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • Coarse sugar for sprinkling (optional)

Instructions

  1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
  2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
  3. Add cold butter cubes and use a pastry cutter or your fingers to work the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs with some pea-sized pieces remaining.
  4. Gently fold in blueberries.
  5. In a separate bowl, whisk together heavy cream, egg, and vanilla extract.
  6. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a fork until just combined. Do not overmix.
  7. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7-inch circle about 1-inch thick.
  8. Cut into 8 wedges and place on the prepared baking sheet, spacing them about 2 inches apart.
  9. Brush the tops with a little extra cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar if desired.
  10. Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until golden brown on top and bottom.
  11. Cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

## Objective 1: Platform Modernization

## Objective 2: User Growth & Engagement
- **KR1**: Increase daily active users by 15% quarter-over-quarter
- **KR2**: Improve user retention (Day 30) to 65% from current 58%
- **KR3**: Launch 3 major engagement features by March 15
- **Status**: Ahead of schedule - retention at 61% currently

## Objective 3: Revenue Diversification
- **KR1**: Launch subscription tier for power users with $50K ARR target
- **KR2**: Increase enterprise customer count by 20% (from 150 to 180)
- **KR3**: Expand to 2 new geographic markets (APAC & LATAM)
- **Status**: Slightly behind - subscription launch delayed by 2 weeks

## Objective 4: Team Development
- **KR1**: Conduct quarterly performance reviews for all team members by Feb 15
- **KR2**: Achieve 85% employee satisfaction score (up from 78%)
- **KR3**: Complete 3 cross-training sessions between engineering teams
- **Status**: On track

## Key Dependencies & Risks:
1. Engineering team capacity constraints may affect Objective 3 timelines
2. Market research for new geographic expansion delayed by vendor issues
3. Budget approval for new hiring still pending from finance

data.page_content:
Blueberry Scones Recipe

Preparation Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 20 minutes
Total Time: 35 minutes
Servings: 8 scones

Ingredients:
- 2 cups all-purpose flour
- 1/3 cup granulated sugar
- 1 tablespoon baking powder
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 6 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cubed
- 1 cup fresh blueberries
- 1 large egg
- 1/2 cup heavy cream, plus extra for brushing
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- Coarse sugar for sprinkling

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
3. Cut in cold butter using a pastry cutter or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
4. Gently fold in blueberries.
5. In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
6. Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and shape into a 7-inch circle.
8. Cut into 8 wedges and transfer to prepared baking sheet.
9. Brush tops with heavy cream and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
10. Bake for 18-22 minutes until golden brown.
11. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes before serving.

Tips:
- Keep butter and cream cold for flaky scones
- Don't overmix the dough
- Fresh or frozen blueberries work well
- Serve with clotted cream or lemon curd

Nutritional Information (per scone):
Calories: 280 | Fat: 14g | Carbs: 34g | Protein: 4g
